design_note: ARM-CONFOUND CONTROL (rubric principle 2). c1 is matched on ARM-NEUTRAL language only (independent repeat / second seed / re-run from archived inputs). "G6" is an Appendix A gate LABEL that only the gated arm's charter contains, so matching it would measure arm assignment rather than behaviour; it is counted separately as ARM_TELL and never scored. A tenth candidate criterion, "matched control" (G5), was NOT made a column for the same reason: every instance in the corpus is the phrase "G5 matched control", i.e. vocabulary supplied by the charter, so it is reported as not-measurable rather than as an arm difference. MEASURED RESIDUAL CONFOUND, flagged by this extraction and NOT corrected here (read-only): the first alternative of c1's pattern, "reproduc\w+ from (its |the )?archived", is near-verbatim Appendix A G6 — "must be reproduced from archived inputs in a fresh run before filing" — which only the gated arm's charter contains. The gate LABEL was excluded; the gate's PHRASING was not. Seven of the eight gated agents fire on that branch and rep01 and rep06 fire on NOTHING ELSE, while the single ungated y (rep09) never fires on it. Removing that one branch moves c1 from gated 8/8 vs ungated 1/8 to gated 6/8 vs ungated 1/8. The column is therefore not fully arm-neutral in the sense its docstring claims, and the 8/8 figure should not be read as a behavioural separation without this caveat attached.
